name: Inflict Wounds
summary: A creature you touch makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 Necrotic damage, half on a success.
text: A creature you touch makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 Necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1.
